Render a list of parsed RAND entries as a rendered bibliography

Source: R/bib-rand.R
rand_bibliography_html.Rd

Each entry is shown as its raw reference-list text, with a live link to its DOI (field doi, e.g. as filled in by rand_resolve_dois()) when one is known; failing that, its plain url (as parsed by rand_parse_entry() from the reference text itself) when one is known; and an explicit "no DOI" marker in either case when no DOI was found.

Usage

rand_bibliography_html(refs, cited_at = NULL)

Arguments

refs

A list of parsed entries (see rand_parse_entry()), such as a subset of rand_parse_chapter_refs() output.

cited_at

A named list, keys matching (a subset of) the entries' citation keys, each value a character vector of anchor ids – typically from bib_cite_link() – to backlink to. Optional.

Value

A character vector of HTML lines (an <ol>).
